new: Your licence and your account live in SpaleHub now — one place for every Spale program. Install SpaleHub, sign in there, and SpaleStudio unlocks itself.
Updates come through SpaleHub as well.
gone: The licence key box and the computer list inside SpaleStudio. Both are in SpaleHub.

new: Licenca i nalog su sada u SpaleHub-u — jedno mesto za sve Spale programe. Instalirajte SpaleHub, prijavite se tamo, i SpaleStudio se sam otključava.
gone: Polje za licencni ključ i spisak računara unutar SpaleStudija. Oba su u SpaleHub-u.

fixed: The welcome screen could not be moved — it covered the whole window, including the part you drag.
Quitting closed the database and the terminals before asking about unsaved work, so Save failed and Cancel left the program gutted.
Using the desktop app logged out every web-access session, repeatedly.
new: Game mode only watches games you choose, and remembers them. Nothing is watched by default.
Choose your games in Settings. Game mode watches those and nothing else, and none are chosen to begin with.
Web access can be given a password — before this the built-in server could not be logged into at all.
fixed: Remote terminals could be opened without a licence.

new: A pink theme — warm rather than sweet, made to be looked at all day. It is beside Dark in the theme button.
Terminals shrink their type when the pane is small, so a shell banner fits instead of wrapping in all four at once.
The overlay, when you open it on purpose, is a proper screen: the game dims behind it, the content is centred, and the way back is where you would look for it.
Roze tema — topla, ne slatka, pravljena da se u nju gleda ceo dan. Stoji pored Dark u dugmetu za temu.
Terminali smanjuju slova kad je okno usko, pa banner stane umesto da se prelomi u sva četiri odjednom.
Overlay, kad ga otvoriš namerno, sada je pravi ekran: igra se zatamni iza njega, sadržaj je na sredini, a izlaz je tamo gde bi ga tražio.
